naive_t2i.label: Naive T2I
naive_t2i.description: Weak baseline. Generate each image from only the current scene text, theme, and style key.

prompt_only_memory.label: Prompt-only Visual Memory
prompt_only_memory.description: Recommended baseline. Use the stored rich image prompt, but pass no previous image or character reference images.

visual_bible.label: Visual Bible
visual_bible.description: Strong no-GPU baseline. Use a fixed text-only visual bible anchored by the first source prompt plus the current scene.

prompt_plus_prev_image.label: Prompt plus previous image
prompt_plus_prev_image.description: Upper reference ablation. Use the rich prompt plus the previously generated image, still without protagonist reference images.

runtime.minimal_prompt_instruction: Generate the next story scene image for the same game world. Use the reference image as the main continuity context. Keep character appearance, outfit, palette, lighting, and key props as consistent as possible. No text, no watermark, no symbols, no garbled characters, no words.
